intervals.label: detector manufacture and H-line construction
intervals.note: Start is the manufacture of the tracking detectors (2017), a lower bound; the H line was reported complete by March 2022 (arXiv:2203.07089).
intervals.quote: Four tracking detectors have been manufactured in 2017

intervals.label: commissioning (last dated status: March 2022)
intervals.note: As of March 2022 DeeMe planned to begin commissioning in April 2022 and initial physics runs in June 2022. No later source was found, so the present status is uncertain; no physics result has been found.
intervals.quote: The H-line construction has been completed and it will become ready for commissioning in January 2022.

name: DeeMe
notes: Status caution: the latest dated source found is March 2022 (arXiv:2203.07089). A 2023 proceedings paper (MDPI Physical Sciences Forum 8, 39) reportedly says the detector is ready to take physics data, but the publisher page returned HTTP 403 and was not read.

physics_goals.quote: The DeeMe experiment is planned to search for muon-to-electron conversion at J-PARC MLF.
physics_goals.value: Search for muon-to-electron conversion at J-PARC MLF with a single event sensitivity of about 1e-13 (graphite target)

summary.plain: An experiment at J-PARC in Japan that searches for a muon turning directly into an electron inside a nucleus, a process the Standard Model does not allow at a measurable rate. Its beamline and spectrometer have been built; no result has been published yet.
summary.technical: DeeMe at the MLF H line: 3 GeV RCS proton bunches on a graphite target, muonic carbon atoms, 105 MeV/c electron spectrometer of a dipole and four MWPCs; design single-event sensitivity 1e-13 (graphite) or 2e-14 (SiC) for mu-e conversion. Commissioning planned for 2022.
